causal_scenarios.effect_np: the rise in chicks fledged per nest
causal_scenarios.alternative_cause: The reserve also removed feral cats from exactly those areas during the same season.
causal_scenarios.reverse_causation: Wardens fitted baffles at the colonies that were already thriving, because those were the ones worth protecting.
causal_scenarios.sampling_flaw: Only colonies reachable from the reserve's single service road were counted, which excludes most of the reserve's interior.
inert_facts: The baffles are manufactured from recycled plastic by a supplier the reserve has used for a decade for its other equipment.
The reserve has published its nesting counts annually since it opened, using the same counting protocol throughout that period.
Chick counts are taken by trained volunteers rather than by reserve staff, as they are at most reserves of comparable size.
The season was slightly wetter than the ten-year average across the whole region, including areas with no colonies at all.
causal_scenarios.control_comparison: Colonies in an adjacent reserve with the same predators and the same weather, but no baffles, fledged no more chicks than before.

causal_scenarios.cause_vp: were burned in the controlled fire
causal_scenarios.effect_vp: showed higher plant diversity the following spring
causal_scenarios.alternative_cause: The burned transects are also the only ones on which the reserve suspended grazing that year, having moved its herd to the northern paddocks.
causal_scenarios.reverse_causation: The reserve selected its most botanically varied transects for burning, since those were the ones the programme was designed to maintain.
causal_scenarios.sampling_flaw: Diversity was recorded on eight of the reserve's ninety transects, all of them within a short walk of the access track.
inert_facts: The controlled burn was carried out over two days rather than the single day the reserve's management plan had originally allowed for.
Plant diversity is recorded as a species count rather than by biomass, which is the convention across the reserve's published surveys.
The reserve borders a national park along its western edge, and the two share a boundary fence maintained by the park authority.
Several of the species recorded on the transects are common throughout the region and appear in surveys of every habitat type in it.
causal_scenarios.control_comparison: Unburned transects with the same soil and rainfall showed no increase in plant diversity that spring.

ratio_scenarios.base_change: The laboratory processed roughly four times as many specimens this season as in its first.
inert_facts: The laboratory replaced its sequencing equipment between the two seasons.
Failed attempts are re-run once before being recorded.
The laboratory reports its figures to the funding body each year.
The laboratory's staffing did not change between the two seasons.
